pre_click_posts:
Update: Lower Treasury yields leave Bitcoin's demand question open


U.S. Department of the Treasury's 10-year yield fell to 4.90% on November 4. Lower interest elsewhere can help Bitcoin's case; it does not establish that buyers are returning.


What to watch: For Bitcoin, the useful distinction is between a lower return on an interest-bearing alternative and evidence that investors want more exposure to a volatile asset.


Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/lower-treasury-yields-leave-bitcoins


Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.


Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
